_doc: UI-diff cases (tools/ui-diff/README.md). Committed; everything else under ui-ref/ is gitignored (D5). Both sides are scripted: port = black-game with BLACK_SCRIPT (fixed frames from power-on: Boot -> Title with 16-frame fades, Title visible from ~79, A at 90 -> NewGame -> Overworld visible from ~184); ref = the DeSmuME core via capture_ref.py (frames from power-on: health screen, A at 400 skips it, intro movie, title screen from ~4900; or from ui-ref/states/<savestate>). ref.frames[i] is compared with port.frames[i]; an entry is an int or a [lo, hi] window (best pair counts). phash is written by capture_ref.py. REFERENCE STATES (make once, ui-ref/states/*.dst, gitignored; capture_ref.py records a fixed-date RTC movie from power-on so the frames do not depend on the host clock; frame numbers of a case that names ref.savestate count from the state). title.dst = title screen: capture_ref.py --save-state title --script "400:A" --at 4800 (power-on frame 4800; the old U1 frames 4900/5000/5200/5400-5410/5500-5510 are now 100/200/400/600-610/700-710 and byte-equal to the power-on captures). overworld.dst = Nuvema Town outdoors in front of the player's house, free control, default name AAAAAAA, Tepig chosen, both rival battles done, mom dialogue done (RTC 2013-06-15 12:00): capture_ref.py --save-state overworld --at 37998 --script "400:A,4900:A,5000:A,5100-15270/30:A,15309:Down,15339-15359/20:Left,15389-15429/20:Down,15469-15489/20:Right,15519:Down,15549-19269/30:A,19308-22278/30:A,22308-25278/30:A,25308-28878/30:A,28908-32478/30:A,32508-32528/20:Up,32558-32698/20:Right,32728-32828/20:Up,32858-32878/20:Left,32898-32998/20:Up,33018:Left,33058-33198/20:Up,33218-33298/20:Right,33318-33498/20:Down,33808-36778/30:A,36808-37228/30:A,37318-37558/20:Down,37578-37638/20:Right,37678-37798/20:Down" (power-on frame numbers, each press held 4 frames; 'LO-HI/STEP:Button' = a press every STEP frames; phases: 400 skip health screen; 4900/5000/5100-15270 title menu -> New Game -> professor intro, A mash through the name entry (A types AAAAAAA, the name is accepted at the Yes prompt), Tepig, credits and the bedroom cutscene; 15309-15519 walk to the gift box (Down, Left x2, Down x3, Right x2, Down); 15549-32478 A mash through the gift box, starter pick, 2 battles (scripted loss to Bianca, win vs Cheren) and the after-talk; 32508-33498 walk Up/Right/Up/Left/Up/Left/Up/Right to the stairs and Down the stairs; 33808-37228 A mash through mom downstairs; 37318-37798 walk Down/Right/Down out of the house; 37998 save).
